attributeDefinition: Date the flight route was flown (date code of the orthomosaic the redd was marked on)
Name of survey location site. Matches "location" in the other tables in this package.
Channel in which the location lies: LFC (low-flow channel) or HFC (high-flow channel)
Survey method. Always "drone" in this table.
Number of redds at the point. 1 for each marked redd point; 0 for a location that was flown on that date with no redds found (from the flight route schedule).
Longitude of the redd point in decimal degrees (WGS84), calculated in ArcGIS Pro from the orthomosaic.
missingValueCodeExplanation: Zero-redd record with no redd point

attributeDefinition: Latitude of the redd point in decimal degrees (WGS84), calculated in ArcGIS Pro from the orthomosaic.
missingValueCodeExplanation: Zero-redd record with no redd point
